name: zreader_find_child_recursive
description: zReader_FindChildRecursive walks array nodes from a caller-provided start index, recurses into nested arrays, and returns the value node adjacent to a matching name string.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the existing zreader_find_child_recursive VC target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48cec0 rejects null and non-array nodes, compares startIndex against the array count, walks array entries from startIndex, recurses into child arrays with start index 1, compares string nodes with the requested name, and returns the adjacent value node on a match.
The native smoke validates direct lookup, nested recursive lookup, start-index skipping, missing-name fallthrough, null input, and non-array guard behavior.
